test.create_query: CREATE TABLE prewhere_lossless_conversion (a Float64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO prewhere_lossless_conversion SELECT 100 + (number % 1000) / 10., concat('i', toString(1 + intHash32(number) % 4)) FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM prewhere_lossless_conversion WHERE toFloat64(a) > 0 AND s = 'i9'
